mentions.name: Glance
mentions.description: This finance app skips budgeting entirely and instead tracks spending and trends, learning the user's spending patterns to flag anomalies such as doubled DoorDash spending, above-normal weekly spending, or forgotten subscriptions still charging. Bank and card connections are managed through Plaid.
mentions.problem: Many people who earn a good living don't want to account for every penny or deal with the complexity of full budgeting apps, but still want a handle on their spending.
mentions.audience: People who earn a good living, know they should save, but don't want the complexity of budgeting apps like Monarch, Copilot, or YNAB — they just want a handle on their spending.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building a landing page for Glance (https://glance-fi.app/) to figure out whether anyone actually wants this before I go deep on it.

It's a finance app (I know — another one, stay with me here) that skips budgeting entirely, instead tracking spending and trends.

It learns your spending patterns and flags anomalies — DoorDash doubled, weekly spending is above normal, a subscription you forgot about is still charging you, etc.
